debit.notes: Customer Care 1800-123-9878 is available 24x7 (365 days) for blocking/hotlisting; it is also the IVR number to call from your registered mobile number. SMS block: send "BLOCK <space> Last 4 Digits of your Card Number" (e.g. BLOCK 1234) to 8108256256 from your registered mobile number; an acknowledgement SMS confirms the request. Netbanking path: www.utkarsh.bank.in > Login > Personal Banking > Cards > Debit Cards > Block Debit Card. Utkarsh Mobile Banking app path: More > Cards > Debit Cards > Block Debit Card. Site-footer toll-free list: 1800 123 9878 (Service), 1800 208 1788 (Micro Banking), 1800 570 3988 (Sales); general customer-care email customercare@utkarsh.bank.in and the Report Unauthorised Transaction portal odr.utkarsh.bank.in/utkarsh-mbank are published in the footer. No overseas helpline is published on these pages.
debit.sms: BLOCK <space> Last 4 Digits of your Card Number (e.g. BLOCK 1234) - send to 8108256256 from your registered mobile number

credit.notes: Credit Card Support 1800-309-3665: the Eternal card page says to call it or email creditcards@utkarsh.bank.in to get the card hot-listed on loss/theft or fraudulent transaction, and its FAQ confirms blocking through Internet Banking and Mobile Banking; no SMS keyword is published for credit cards. PhonePe co-branded Wish secured card: block or freeze via the 'Block and Replace' feature under card settings > Manage in the PhonePe app, or call Secured Card Support 1800-309-7986 / email securedcc@utkarsh.bank.in. 1800-123-9878 is the bank's generic Service line (24x7, 365 days). No overseas helpline is published on these pages.

upi.notes: In-app (standalone Utkarsh UPI app, not U One): the bank publishes no UPI on/off or freeze toggle — the documented exit is deregistering: open the app, tap the three horizontal lines (top left), tap 'Deregister', then 'OK'; re-registration is required afterwards and also after changing handset/SIM. Entering the wrong UPI PIN more than 3 times auto-blocks UPI for 24 hours ('users UPI will be blocked for 24 hours'). Phone: 'You can approach our Call Center Team on the following Toll Free numbers: 1800 208 1788 / 1800 123 9878'; email customercare@utkarsh.bank (UPI page; site footer uses customercare@utkarsh.bank.in). Failed UPI transaction disputes: View All > Failed Transaction > Raise Dispute in the app; unauthorised transactions can be reported at odr.utkarsh.bank.in/utkarsh-mbank. No SMS keyword, no *99# mention and no netbanking UPI-manage path is published; the Block Debit Card page covers cards only, not UPI (block-debit-card, mobile-banking, cybersecurity and FAQs pages checked 2026-11-01).
